passage.label: Allah heard speech of one who argues concerning her husband and directs complaint to Allah, He hears your dialogue, Hearing Seeing; those pronouncing zihar from wives are not their mothers, mothers only those who gave birth, objectionable statement and falsehood, yet Pardoning Forgiving; those pronouncing zihar then wishing to go back must free a slave before touching one another, admonished thereby, Acquainted with what you do; whoever finds none fasts two consecutive months before touching, whoever unable feeds sixty poor persons, that you believe completely in Allah and His Messenger, these are the limits of Allah, painful punishment for disbelievers

arabicExcerpts.text: قَدۡ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوۡلَ ٱلَّتِي تُجَٰدِلُكَ فِي زَوۡجِهَا وَتَشۡتَكِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسۡمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ

ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَٰتِهِمۡۖ إِنۡ أُمَّهَٰتُهُمۡ إِلَّا ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔي وَلَدۡنَهُمۡۚ وَإِنَّهُمۡ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَزُورٗاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٞ
وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمۡ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُواْ فَتَحۡرِيرُ رَقَبَةٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۚ ذَٰلِكُمۡ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

فَمَن لَّمۡ يَجِدۡ فَصِيَامُ شَهۡرَيۡنِ مُتَتَابِعَيۡنِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّاۖ فَمَن لَّمۡ يَسۡتَطِعۡ فَإِطۡعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسۡكِينٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦۚ وَتِلۡكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِۗ وَلِلۡكَٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

mainSubject.label: The pleading woman's argument concerning her husband heard by Allah who hears the whole dialogue as Hearing and Seeing; the zihar formula repudiated because a wife is not a mother, mothers being only those who gave birth, the utterance named objectionable and false while pardon and forgiveness remain open; retraction conditioned on freeing a slave before marital contact resumes, with divine acquaintance affirmed; inability met by two consecutive months of fasting, and further inability by feeding sixty poor persons, all framed as completing belief in Allah and His Messenger within His set limits, with painful punishment reserved for disbelievers

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the zihar expiation ladder and divine limits (4) before the opposition-and-abasement block opens (5); P2 ends with the Satanic-whispering diagnosis and reliance command (10) before assembly etiquette begins (11); P3 covers assembly conduct and the consultation-charity rule with its concession (11-13); P4 runs from the false-alliance critique through the two parties to the closing success declaration (14-22).
